structure.content: The Hermit holds a strong soul, with roots entwinned into the tree of life.
structure.placeholderdescription: Your staff is glimmering with crystals that carry the wills of the departed. You are their keeper, and their reaper.

options.label: Orc
options.description: Among the peoples of The Land, Orcs are recognized as the children of The Beast. They are of life and of blood, and they thrive on history and story.

move.name: Refreshing
move.description:
When you cast a spell:
* On a mixed success, recover 2 HP.
* On a full success, you may instead heal a creature in your line of sight for 2 HP.
* On a failure, you lose connection to the weave, this move is disabled until your next rest.

options.label: Elf
options.description: Personally created by The Flower, Elves are the first people of The Land. Not one has yet died of old age. They are of the wind, and it keeps their songs for them.

move.name: Hollistic
move.description:
You may treat all creatures as animals for the purpose of abilities, moves, and spells.
(For example, Speak With Animals allows communication with any creature, no matter how strange.)

options.label: Dwarf
options.description: Born in the depths, from the dreams of The Stone, Dwarves have only recently emerged to the surface. They are artisans and engineers, materializing their ideas into reality.

move.name: Thanatologist
move.description:
When you loot a fallen enemy you personally downed, roll +Weird instead of +Mind.
* On a success treat this as a full success on the loot roll.
* On a 10+, you also uncover their life rune—a symbol of who they were. You may spend it to invoke a powerful effect of the GM's choice.
* On a miss, a specter of death will follow you until you are ritually cleansed.

options.label: City
options.description: You cut your teeth in organized society, within system and structure. You were trained as part of a historied tradition, but you have chosen to break from it.

move.name: Pious
move.description:
Describe the church where you took your vows: its deity, its core tenet, and the service you still uphold.
When you discern realities, a full success comes with a revelation from your god.
If you act against your vows, lose this move until you perform an act of atonement.

options.label: Town
options.description: You grew up in a small community, where everyone knew each other. You learned the value of cooperation and the strength of bonds.

move.name: Wanderer
move.description:
Your body is adapted to nature's rhythms.
When you make a refuge roll in the wilderness, you may choose a full success instead of rolling.

options.label: Enclave
options.description: You were born and raised in a roaming band of warriors. You may now thrive in common society, but you still carry the unorthodox ways of your people.

move.name: Wildling
move.description:
When others would create a companion, instead describe your animal form.
Add +1 to two of its stats. You may switch between your forms at will.
